description: Refactor admin Users section to have a sub-menu before requiring a user ID. The sub-menu shows options: Search User (by ID), Bonus All Users, Bonus Top 10. Only per-user actions (Ban, Add Balance, Remove Balance, Add Bonus, Remove Bonus) appear AFTER searching a specific user by ID.
steps: 1. Add a new FSM state `user_menu` to AdminFlow (after `user_search` state around line 1900) that represents the Users sub-menu.
2. Add a new button constant: BTN_SEARCH_USER = _b('🔍 Search User') around line 717 with the other admin user action buttons.
3. Create a new keyboard function `admin_users_menu_kb()` that shows: [BTN_SEARCH_USER], [BTN_BONUS_ALL_USERS, BTN_BONUS_TOP10], [BACK_BTN, HOME_BTN].
4. Modify the `admin_users` handler (line 5678) to set state to `AdminFlow.user_menu` instead of `AdminFlow.user_search`, show total users count, and use the new `admin_users_menu_kb()` keyboard.

5. Create a new handler `@router_admin.message(AdminFlow.user_menu)` that handles: BTN_SEARCH_USER -> set state to user_search and ask for ID; BTN_BONUS_ALL_USERS -> set state to bonus_all_amount and ask for amount; BTN_BONUS_TOP10 -> set state to bonus_top10_amount and ask for amount; BACK_BTN/HOME_BTN -> return to admin main menu.
6. Remove BTN_BONUS_ALL_USERS and BTN_BONUS_TOP10 from the `admin_user_actions_kb()` keyboard (line 2173). It should only show: ban/unban, add/remove balance, add/remove bonus, back, home.
7. Update the BACK_BTN handler in `admin_user_action` (AdminFlow.user_detail state, line 5723) to go back to `AdminFlow.user_menu` with `admin_users_menu_kb()` instead of going to `user_search`.

8. Update the cancel/back handlers in `admin_bonus_all_amount` (line 5979) and `admin_bonus_top10_amount` (line 6113) to return to `AdminFlow.user_menu` with `admin_users_menu_kb()` instead of `AdminFlow.user_detail` with user_actions_kb (since these are now accessed from the sub-menu, not from a specific user).
9. Update the completion callbacks `admin_bonusall_done` and `admin_bonustop_done` to return to `AdminFlow.user_menu` with `admin_users_menu_kb()` instead of `AdminFlow.user_detail`.
10. Update the `admin_search_user` handler (line 5688) BACK_BTN handling to return to `AdminFlow.user_menu` with `admin_users_menu_kb()` instead of admin main menu.
acceptance_criteria: Pressing '👥 Users' in admin shows a sub-menu with Search User, Bonus All Users, Bonus Top 10 options
Pressing 'Search User' asks for user ID, then shows user details + per-user actions (ban, balance, bonus for that user only)
Per-user action keyboard no longer includes Bonus All Users or Bonus Top 10
Bonus All Users and Bonus Top 10 are accessible directly from the users sub-menu without needing a user ID first
Back button from user detail returns to the users sub-menu
Back button from users sub-menu returns to admin main menu
Cancel/back from bonus_all/bonus_top10 amount input returns to users sub-menu
python -c "import py_compile; py_compile.compile('bot.py', doraise=True)" passes without errors
verification: grep -n 'user_menu' bot.py to confirm new state exists
grep -n 'admin_users_menu_kb' bot.py to confirm new keyboard exists
grep -n 'BTN_SEARCH_USER' bot.py to confirm new button exists
findings: All changes implemented and verified. Syntax check passes. python3 command needed (not python) due to pyenv setup. The bonus_all and bonus_top10 flows now return to user_menu consistently. Post-review refactoring: extracted 9 duplicated menu-rendering blocks into a single _show_user_menu(target, state) helper function placed after admin_users_menu_kb(). Net reduction of 63 lines.
